339-677-2034-8201.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha, adding {C}{C}
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

765-950-2645-3430.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7235.easyPrerequisites: There are at least X total creatures on the battlefield.
728-6972-7235.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Stag Beetle.
When Stag Beetle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2744-5641-6566.notablePrerequisites: Basking Broodscale does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2744-5641-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.
Activate Basking Broodscale's adapt ability by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-1671-7893.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1876-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1876-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Worldwaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

4321-5670-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 3.
4321-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token, a Food token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat step 1 one additional time.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate a Food by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.
4321-5670-6291.notes: Once you have infinite life, you may forego sacrificing the Foods and/or Treasures.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5475-5921-5970-7730.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

6913-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
6913-7009-7715.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

240-5470-5686-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1322-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

11-121-4377-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-121-4377-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Walk the Aeons.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Walk the Aeons spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Walk the Aeons spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Walk the Aeons and returning the original Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Walk the Aeons from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

4222-5475-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

681-5414-5478-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5414-5478-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 2.

1482-2866-4986-6797.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet

390-2228-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Hulking Metamorph.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hulking Metamorph by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1170-1418-4124-5954-6763.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3918-4306-5090.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least seven.
3918-4306-5090.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding seven mana of any color that you have devotion to.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

215-2792-3152-5922.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
Helga does not have summoning sickness and has power 7 or greater.
215-2792-3152-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to its power that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or with {X} in their mana cost.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Cast Great Whale by paying its mana cost.
Helga and Chakram Retriever trigger.
Resolve the Helga trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life, and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
Resolve the Chakram Retriever trigger, untapping Helga.
Resolve the Great Whale spell.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1247-5704-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5704-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Leafkin Avenger's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

876-2034-2820-4679.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Yenna.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

654-3129-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
654-3129-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
654-3129-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Resolve both Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping both Everywhere tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1689-4067-5764.description:
Activate Oggyar Battle-Seer by tapping it, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Oggyar Battle-Seer.
Repeat.

4050-5663--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4050-5663--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

338-678-2060-2123-2292.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
You have at least two opponents.
338-678-2060-2123-2292.description:
Cast Kokusho by paying {4}{B}{B}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kokusho.
When Kokusho dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Kokusho trigger, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1624-3625-3646-4973.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-3625-3646-4973.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
1624-3625-3646-4973.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Storvald either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become 1.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1467-3634-4568-4872.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-3634-4568-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Time Warp to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3542-4974.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six mana-producing lands, two of which can produce at least {U}.
3542-4974.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Zendikar Resurgent's first ability triggers six times, adding {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Zendikar Resurgent's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1365-4659-4853-4907.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Tatterkite persist until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Tatterkite, adding {C}{C}.
Tatterkite dies, triggering its persist ability and Dross Scorpion.
Resolve the Tatterkite trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters on it.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.

803-1558-3263-3413.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Human" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1558-3263-3413.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creatures.
The creatures die, triggering Xathrid Necromancer five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2104-2497-5261.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Reclaim without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Reclaim, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
